title: Sunflower Veil Bride
description: A young woman with closed eyes and golden face markings stands centered, wearing an elaborate headdress and sheer veil made of yellow sunflower petals and leaves. She holds a large blooming sunflower with both hands against her chest, dressed in a dark blue and purple gown with golden embroidery and tassels.
prompt: A solemn young woman with closed eyes and golden glitter markings on her face, wearing an intricate headdress and translucent veil crafted from sunflower petals and leaves. She holds a large vibrant sunflower with both hands, dressed in a dark blue gown with golden embroidery and tassels. Dramatic golden light rays pierce through a dark blue and purple background, painterly fantasy style with rich textures and luminous atmosphere.
